season.title: Highest Scoring Average
season.description: Best points-per-game in a single regular season.

season.title: Most Wins in a Season
season.description: Most regular-season wins. Season lengths differ; the game count is shown.

season.title: Most 150-Point Games
season.description: Most weeks above 150 points in one season.

season.title: Most Sub-100 Games
season.description: Most weeks below 100 points in one season.

season.title: Most Consistent Season
season.description: Lowest week-to-week standard deviation (minimum 8 games). Consistency is not the same as quality -- a reliably bad team scores here too.

career.title: Career Wins
career.description: Total regular-season wins across every season in the league.

career.title: Career Winning Percentage
career.description: Regular-season win percentage, minimum 20 games played.

career.title: Career Points For
career.description: Total regular-season points scored. Favours long-tenured owners.

career.title: Career Scoring Average
career.description: Career points per game, minimum 20 games played.

career.title: Playoff Appearances
career.description: Seasons in which the owner played at least one winners-bracket game.

career.title: Best Average Finish
career.description: Mean final standing across seasons where ESPN reported one. League size has changed over time, so a finish of 6th in a 10-team season is not identical to 6th in a 12-team season.

career.title: Longest Winning Streak
career.description: Longest run of consecutive regular-season wins, spanning seasons.

career.title: Longest Losing Streak
career.description: Longest run of consecutive regular-season losses, spanning seasons.
